        （携带 Retry-After）、BINDING_CHANGED、TASK_REPLACED、
        PHOTO_VERSION_CONFLICT、DEVICE_OCCUPIED、PLAN_NOT_READY、
        PLAN_COMPLETED、EXECUTION_NOT_RESUMABLE、RECORD_CONFLICT、
        CLOSURE_GAPS、STOP_NOT_CONFIRMED、BOUND_TO_OTHER。details 只含
        调用方可见的冲突字段/缺失序号。
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
        Retry-After: { $ref: '#/components/headers/RetryAfter' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    PayloadTooLarge:
      description: 413 UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE（开发初值：单图 10MiB / 三图 32MiB）
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    UnsupportedMediaType:
      description: 415 UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE——图片格式不支持（实际格式校验，非仅 MIME）
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    UnprocessableEntity:
      description: 422 FACE_QUALITY_REJECTED——人脸质量/视角不合格（新逻辑请求用新键）
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    TooManyRequests:
      description: 429 RATE_LIMITED——受限重试
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
        Retry-After: { $ref: '#/components/headers/RetryAfter' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    InternalError:
      description: 500 INTERNAL——未知/未映射异常；仅 requestId 可诊断，不外泄堆栈
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    NotImplemented:
      description: >-
        501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED——业务端点为 contract-only 占位
        （x-implementation: contract-only），由 B/C/D 包实现；未实现前一律
        返回本信封，绝不伪造 200 假成功。客户端须容忍 details 未来新增字段。
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotImplementedEnvelope' }
    DependencyUnavailable:
      description: 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE——外部依赖不可用；绝不默认核验通过
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    DependencyTimeout:
      description: 504 DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT——外部依赖超时；retryable=true 时同键重试
      headers:
        X-Request-Id: { $ref: '#/components/headers/XRequestId' }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
  schemas:
    # ---------- 信封与通用 ----------
    BigintString:
      type: string
      pattern: '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
      description: >-
        无符号 64 位整数的十进制字符串（N/K、revision、seq、计数）。服务端在
        数据库做 bigint 运算并检查溢出；signed 变体 `^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$`
        在 MVP 契约中不使用。
    Rfc3339Utc:
      type: string
      format: date-time
      description: RFC 3339 UTC 时间，例如 2026-09-10T04:00:00Z；客户端时间只供诊断
    EnvelopeMeta:
      type: object
      required: [replayed, serverTime]
      additionalProperties: true
      description: 客户端必须容忍响应新增字段
      properties:
        replayed:
          type: boolean
          description: true 表示本响应来自 T13 幂等重放（原业务结果，不重做写入）
        serverTime: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
    SuccessEnvelope:
      type: object
      required: [requestId, data, meta]
      additionalProperties: false
      description: 成功响应信封（204 无响应体，requestId 走 X-Request-Id 头）
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: 本次 HTTP 尝试 ID（与 X-Request-Id 头一致；≠T13.id）
        data:
          type: object
          description: 业务数据（各端点以 allOf 覆盖具体 schema）
        meta: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EnvelopeMeta' }
    ListData:
      type: object
      required: [items, nextCursor]
      description: 列表响应 data 形状；具体端点用 allOf 收紧 items 元素类型
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items: {}
        nextCursor:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          description: 不透明游标；null 表示无后续页
    ErrorCode:
      type: string
      description: 稳定业务原因码（DD 3.2 错误码表 + NOT_IMPLEMENTED 基础层扩展）
      enum:
        - INVALID_INPUT
        - UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE
        - UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE
        - FACE_QUALITY_REJECTED
        - AUTH_REQUIRED
        - SESSION_INVALID
        - RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE
        - CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED
        - FACE_NOT_VERIFIED
        - IDEMPOTENCY_CONTENT_CONFLICT
        - BINDING_CHANGED
        - TASK_REPLACED
        - PHOTO_VERSION_CONFLICT
        - DEVICE_OCCUPIED
        - PLAN_NOT_READY
        - PLAN_COMPLETED
        - EXECUTION_NOT_RESUMABLE
        - RECORD_CONFLICT
        - CLOSURE_GAPS
        - STOP_NOT_CONFIRMED
        - REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        - RATE_LIMITED
        - DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE
        - DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT
        - GRANT_REVOKED
        - BOUND_TO_OTHER
        - UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT
        - NOT_IMPLEMENTED
    ErrorEnvelope:
      type: object
      required: [requestId, error]
      additionalProperties: false
      description: >-
        错误信封。message 为人类可读摘要，不泄露供应商密钥/堆栈/人脸候选；
        details 只含调用方可见的冲突字段/缺失序号。各端点适用码见操作级
        x-error-codes。
      properties:
        requestId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        error:
          type: object
          required: [code, message, retryable]
          additionalProperties: false
          properties:
            code: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorCode' }
            message: { type: string }
            retryable: { type: boolean }
            details:
              type: object
              nullable: true
              additionalProperties: true
    NotImplementedEnvelope:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
        - type: object
          properties:
            error:
              type: object
              properties:
                code: { type: string, enum: [NOT_IMPLEMENTED] }
                retryable: { type: boolean }
                details:
                  type: object
                  additionalProperties: true
                  description: 可含 apiId、plannedPackage 等调用方可见提示
    # ---------- 通用业务结构（DD 6.x） ----------
    Capture:
      type: object
      description: >-
        采集与核验关联（DD 6.2）。capturedAt/captureId/图片哈希由客户端
        提交，不单独证明新鲜性；服务端派生 actor 与 task/plan/execution
        上下文并与证据绑定。x-detail: skeleton（活体/采集凭据待设备与
        SDK 协议）。purpose 仅 grant/admission/revalidation；云台三视角
        采集为 assessment（后端派生）。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [captureId, capturedAt, clientContinuityId, purpose]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        captureId: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128, description: 客户端采集标识（去重/引用） }
        capturedAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
        clientContinuityId: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128, description: 客户端使用者连续性标识 }
        purpose: { type: string, enum: [grant, admission, revalidation] }
        captureProofRef: { type: string, nullable: true, description: 采集证明引用（可选） }
    Verification:
      type: object
      description: >-
        核验结果（DD 6.2）。validUntil 是本响应可用于端侧首次启动/恢复的
        时间边界；时间未到也不能无视换人——端侧连续性失效立即作废。
      required: [verificationRevision, captureId, clientContinuityId, verifiedAt, applicablePurpose, replayed]
      additionalProperties: true
      properties:
        verificationRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        captureId: { type: string }
        clientContinuityId: { type: string }
        verifiedAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
        validUntil: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }], nullable: true }
        applicablePurpose: { type: string, enum: [grant, admission, revalidation, assessment] }
        replayed: { type: boolean, description: 重放响应不获得新的启动有效性 }
    Progress:
      type: object
      description: >-
        方案进度（DD 6.1 示例）。未 ready 时 targetCount/isCompleted 可为
        null，不用 0 表示“已完成”；剩余 = max(N-K,0)；完成条件 K>=N；
        K 不截断。bigint 全为字符串。
      required: [completedCount, remainingCount, progressRevision]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        targetCount: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }], nullable: true }
        completedCount: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        remainingCount: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        isCompleted: { type: boolean, nullable: true }
        progressRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        completedAt: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }], nullable: true }
    ProgressWithSync:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Progress'
        - type: object
          description: >-
            M4-A08 附加最后同步信息（从业务更新时间/入账摘要取得，不伪造
            设备实时值）。x-detail: skeleton
          x-detail: skeleton
          properties:
            lastSyncedAt: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }], nullable: true }
    # ---------- M1 ----------
    M1A01Metadata:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M1-A01 multipart `metadata` part（application/json）。不得提交目标
        memberId 强制授权；未知业务写字段拒绝（additionalProperties false）。
      required: [capture, consentEvidenceRef]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        capture: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Capture' }
        consentEvidenceRef: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128, description: 人脸同意证据引用（合规前提见 DD 14 节） }
    MemberAccessGrantResult:
      type: object
      description: M1-A01 输出（DD：grantId、memberId、status、grantedAt；无匹配不返回候选列表）
      required: [grantId, memberId, status, grantedAt]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        grantId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        memberId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        status: { type: string, enum: [active] }
        grantedAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
    MemberAccessGrantListItem:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M1-A02 items 元素（DD）：grantId、memberId、grantedAt、memberSummary。
        展示摘要来自 T02 本行，结构未冻结（x-detail: skeleton）。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [grantId, memberId, grantedAt]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        grantId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        memberId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        grantedAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
        memberSummary: { type: object, additionalProperties: true, description: 成员展示摘要（结构未冻结） }
    MemberAccessGrantListData:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ListData'
        - type: object
          properties:
            items:
              type: array
              items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberAccessGrantListItem' }
    # ---------- M2 ----------
    GimbalSessionRequest:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M2-A01 输入：设备凭据、credentialVersion、认证提供方要求的
        nonce/proof。设备签名算法/密钥预置由设备团队对接——字段为占位
        （x-detail: skeleton），协议冻结前不得当作最终格式。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [credential, credentialVersion, proof]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        credential: { type: string, description: 设备凭据（格式待定） }
        credentialVersion: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        proof: { type: string, description: 提供方要求的 nonce/proof（格式待定） }
    GimbalSession:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M2-A01 输出（DD：gimbalId、会话凭据、expiresAt、serverTime；不返回
        成员资料）。凭据字段名待会话协议冻结（x-detail: skeleton）。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [gimbalId, sessionToken, expiresAt, serverTime]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        gimbalId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        sessionToken: { type: string, description: 云台设备会话 token（后续请求 Bearer 使用） }
        expiresAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
        serverTime: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
    GimbalHeartbeatRequest:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M2-A02 输入（DD）：observationEpoch、observationSeq、observedAt、
        powerState、可选 taskId/executionId 与 incidents[]。epoch/seq 为心跳
        去重与顺序依据；异常枚举/严重度/频率待定（x-detail: skeleton）。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [observationEpoch, observationSeq, observedAt, powerState]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        observationEpoch: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128 }
        observationSeq: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        observedAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
        powerState: { type: string, enum: [awake, asleep], description: 清醒/休眠；扩展枚举待定 }
        taskId: { allOf: [{ type: string, format: uuid }], nullable: true }
        executionId: { allOf: [{ type: string, format: uuid }], nullable: true }
        incidents:
          type: array
          description: 云台可检测并上报的异常代码与摘要（枚举待定）
          items: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
    GimbalHeartbeatAck:
      type: object
      description: M2-A02 输出（DD）：接收确认、后端记录时间；可提示需对账，不下发动作命令
      required: [accepted, lastSeenAt, statusRevision, serverTime]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        accepted: { type: boolean, description: 本次心跳是否推进了后端状态（旧序号=false 但仍确认收到） }
        lastSeenAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
        statusRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        serverTime: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
    GimbalStatusView:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M2-A03 输出（DD）：connectionStatus、powerState、lastSeenAt、isStale、
        statusRevision、已知异常摘要。在线/离线等枚举编码未冻结
        （x-detail: skeleton）。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [connectionStatus, isStale, statusRevision]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        connectionStatus: { type: string, description: 在线/离线/未知标记（编码待定） }
        powerState: { type: string, nullable: true, description: 清醒/休眠（编码待定） }
        lastSeenAt: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }], nullable: true }
        isStale: { type: boolean, description: 状态是否过期/未知（不得伪装成实时） }
        statusRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        incidents:
          type: array
          items: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
          description: 已知异常摘要（结构待定）
    MicrocrystalObservationRequest:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M2-A04 输入（DD）：microcrystalSerial、connectionProof、
        capabilities{schemaVersion,revision,parameterRanges,...}、
        observationEpoch/Seq、observedAt、state。能力参数名/单位必须来自
        已验证的微晶协议——capabilities/state 具体结构待定
        （x-detail: skeleton）。未知业务写字段拒绝。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [microcrystalSerial, connectionProof, capabilities, observationEpoch, observationSeq, observedAt, state]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        microcrystalSerial: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128 }
        connectionProof: { type: string, description: 绑定控制端+微晶+当前连接的证明（不接受仅序列号） }
        capabilities:
          type: object
          required: [schemaVersion, revision]
          additionalProperties: true
          properties:
            schemaVersion: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
            revision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        observationEpoch: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128 }
        observationSeq: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        observedAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
        state: { type: object, additionalProperties: true, description: 实际观察状态（结构待定） }
    MicrocrystalObservationAck:
      type: object
      description: M2-A04 输出（DD）：microcrystalId、accepted、capabilityRevision、receivedAt（可信归属校验结果体现在状态码）
      required: [microcrystalId, accepted, capabilityRevision, receivedAt]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        microcrystalId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        accepted: { type: boolean }
        capabilityRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        receivedAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
    MicrocrystalCapabilitiesView:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M2-A05 输出（DD）：capabilities、capabilityRevision、observedAt、
        receivedAt、isStale。capabilities 结构来自微晶协议
        （x-detail: skeleton）。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [capabilities, capabilityRevision, isStale]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        capabilities: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
        capabilityRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        observedAt: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }], nullable: true }
        receivedAt: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }], nullable: true }
        isStale: { type: boolean }
    GimbalBindingRequest:
      type: object
      description: M2-A06 输入（DD）：expectedBindingRevision、pairingProof
      required: [expectedBindingRevision, pairingProof]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        expectedBindingRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        pairingProof: { type: string, description: 可验证配对证明（绑定云台+账号/安装+purpose+nonce+有效期+签名；格式待设备协议） }
    GimbalBindingResult:
      type: object
      description: M2-A06 输出（DD）：bindingStatus=self、gimbalId、bindingRevision、boundAt
      required: [bindingStatus, gimbalId, bindingRevision, boundAt]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        bindingStatus: { type: string, enum: [self] }
        gimbalId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        bindingRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        boundAt: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rfc3339Utc' }
    GimbalBindingStatusView:
      type: object
      description: M2-A07 输出（DD）：bindingStatus=unbound/self/other、bindingRevision；不返回他人账号 ID/手机号
      required: [bindingStatus, bindingRevision]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        bindingStatus: { type: string, enum: [unbound, self, other] }
        bindingRevision: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
    # ---------- M3 ----------
    M3A01Metadata:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M3-A01 multipart `metadata` part。三图 part 名固定 front/left/right；
        photoVersion 首次为 "1"；captureSessionId 为云台本轮采集会话标识
        （客户端去重/关联字段）。
      required: [photoVersion, captureSessionId, consentEvidenceRef]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        photoVersion: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        captureSessionId: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128 }
        consentEvidenceRef: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128 }
    M3A02Metadata:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M3-A02 multipart `metadata` part。replacedViews 为本次更换视角清单；
        新版本完整视角清单由服务端构造，未更换视角沿用本任务已接纳图片。
      required: [expectedPhotoVersion, replacedViews]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        expectedPhotoVersion: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        replacedViews:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          uniqueItems: true
          items: { type: string, enum: [front, left, right] }
    AssessmentTaskAccepted:
      type: object
      description: M3-A01/M3-A02 受理输出（DD）：taskId、status=queued、photoVersion、currentAssessmentRevision
      required: [taskId, status, photoVersion]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        taskId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        status: { type: string, enum: [queued] }
        photoVersion: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        currentAssessmentRevision: { allOf: [{ $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }], nullable: true }
    AssessmentTaskView:
      type: object
      description: >-
        M3-A03 输出（DD）：taskId、status、photoVersion、requiredViews[]、
        可公开 failureCode/retryable；ready 时 reportId；方案任务可查询关联
        提示。云台仅当前任务可读；APP 按独立成员查看授权读取。
      x-detail: skeleton
      required: [taskId, status, photoVersion, requiredViews]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        taskId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        status: { type: string, enum: [queued, analyzing, needs_retake, report_ready, failed] }
        photoVersion: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BigintString' }
        requiredViews:
          type: array
          items: { type: string, enum: [front, left, right] }
          description: 需补拍视角
        failureCode: { type: string, nullable: true, description: 可公开失败编码 }
        retryable: { type: boolean, nullable: true }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify backend/contracts/samples against the shared contract schemas.

1. Every samples/jobs/*.json payload validates against its JSON Schema
   (draft 2020-12, schemas/ directory, cross-file $refs via registry).
2. Envelope & multipart-metadata samples validate against the OpenAPI
   components/schemas they are governed by (openapi/openapi.yaml), after a
   minimal OpenAPI-3.0 -> JSON-Schema-2020-12 adaptation (nullable handling,
   component $ref rewriting).
3. Every canonicalization vector's expected_sha256 is recomputed with the
   reference RFC 8785 implementation in scripts/jcs.py.

Exit code is nonzero on any failure. Run from anywhere:
    python3 scripts/validate_samples.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import pathlib
import sys

CONTRACTS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(CONTRACTS / "scripts"))

import jcs  # noqa: E402  (reference JCS implementation)
import yaml  # noqa: E402
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator  # noqa: E402
from referencing import Registry, Resource  # noqa: E402

SCHEMAS_DIR = CONTRACTS / "schemas"
OPENAPI_FILE = CONTRACTS / "openapi" / "openapi.yaml"
SAMPLES = CONTRACTS / "samples"

FAILURES: list[str] = []
CHECKS = 0


def fail(label: str, detail: str) -> None:
    FAILURES.append(f"{label}: {detail}")
    print(f"FAIL {label}: {detail}")


def ok(label: str) -> None:
    global CHECKS
    CHECKS += 1
    print(f"ok   {label}")


def load_json(path: pathlib.Path):
    return jcs.load_strict(path.read_text("utf-8"))


# ---------------- JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) ----------------

def jsonschema_registry() -> Registry:
    resources = []
    for p in sorted(SCHEMAS_DIR.glob("*.json")):
        contents = json.loads(p.read_text("utf-8"))
        sid = contents.get("$id")
        if not sid:
            fail("schema-ids", f"{p.name} has no $id")
            continue
        resources.append((sid, Resource.from_contents(contents)))
    return Registry().with_resources(resources)


def validate_with_jsonschema(instance, schema_uri: str, registry: Registry, label: str) -> None:
    schema_resource = registry.get_schema({"$ref": schema_uri})
    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema_resource.contents, registry=registry)
    errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(instance), key=lambda e: e.json_path)
    if errors:
        fail(label, "; ".join(f"{e.json_path}: {e.message}" for e in errors[:5]))
    else:
        ok(label)


JOB_PAYLOAD_MAP = {
    "system-echo.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-system-echo.json",
    "assessment-analyze.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-assessment-analyze.json",
    "identity-enroll.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-identity-enroll.json",
    "plan-generate.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-plan-generate.json",
    "notification-deliver.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-notification-deliver.json",
    "media-cleanup.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-media-cleanup.json",
}


# ---------------- OpenAPI 3.0 -> JSON Schema adaptation ----------------

def openapi_to_jsonschema(node):
    """Recursively adapt OpenAPI 3.0 schema objects to draft 2020-12."""
    if isinstance(node, list):
        return [openapi_to_jsonschema(x) for x in node]
    if not isinstance(node, dict):
        return node
    node = {k: openapi_to_jsonschema(v) for k, v in node.items()}
    # rewrite component refs to absolute registry URNs
    ref = node.get("$ref")
    if isinstance(ref, str) and ref.startswith("#/components/schemas/"):
        node["$ref"] = f"urn:mvp:contracts:openapi:{ref.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]}"
    # drop OpenAPI-only keywords unknown to strict vocabularies (harmless annotations)
    nullable = node.pop("nullable", False)
    node.pop("example", None)
    node.pop("discriminator", None)
    if nullable is True:
        if "type" in node and isinstance(node["type"], str):
            node["type"] = [node["type"], "null"]
        elif "allOf" in node:
            node = {"anyOf": [node, {"type": "null"}]}
    return node


def openapi_registry() -> Registry:
    doc = yaml.safe_load(OPENAPI_FILE.read_text("utf-8"))
    components = doc["components"]["schemas"]
    resources = []
    for name, schema in components.items():
        adapted = openapi_to_jsonschema(schema)
        adapted["$schema"] = "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
        adapted["$id"] = f"urn:mvp:contracts:openapi:{name}"
        resources.append((adapted["$id"], Resource.from_contents(adapted)))
    return Registry().with_resources(resources)


def validate_with_openapi(instance, component: str, registry: Registry, label: str) -> None:
    resource = registry.get_schema({"$ref": f"urn:mvp:contracts:openapi:{component}"})
    validator = Draft202012Validator(resource.contents, registry=registry)
    errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(instance), key=lambda e: e.json_path)
    if errors:
        fail(label, "; ".join(f"{e.json_path}: {e.message}" for e in errors[:5]))
    else:
        ok(label)


# ---------------- canonicalization vectors ----------------

def check_vectors() -> None:
    path = SAMPLES / "canonicalization" / "vectors.json"
    vectors = load_json(path)
    if not isinstance(vectors, list) or not vectors:
        fail("vectors", "vectors.json must be a non-empty array")
        return
    seen = set()
    for v in vectors:
        name = v.get("name", "<unnamed>")
        if name in seen:
            fail("vectors-dup-name", name)
        seen.add(name)
        actual = jcs.sha256_hex(v["input"])
        if actual != v["expected_sha256"]:
            fail(f"vector {name}", f"expected {v['expected_sha256']} got {actual}")
        else:
            ok(f"vector {name}")
    by_name = {v["name"]: v["expected_sha256"] for v in vectors}
    pairs = [
        ("nested-out-of-order-keys-a", "nested-out-of-order-keys-b-equal-hash-to-a", True),
        ("defaults-expanded-equal-pair-a", "defaults-expanded-equal-pair-b-equal-hash-to-a", True),
        ("array-order-significant-front-left-right", "array-order-significant-reversed-different-hash", False),
        ("near-collision-closure-final-count-3", "near-collision-closure-final-count-4-different-hash", False),
    ]
    for a, b, equal in pairs:
        if a not in by_name or b not in by_name:
            fail("vector-pair", f"missing {a or b}")
            continue
        if (by_name[a] == by_name[b]) != equal:
            fail("vector-pair", f"{a} vs {b}: expected equal={equal}")
        else:
            ok(f"vector pair {a} {'==' if equal else '!='} {b}")

# T13 payload_hash 与跨语言规范化 JSON 规范（canonicalization）

状态：A 包公共契约（Java Web 与 Python Worker 必须实现同一规范）。
参考实现：`scripts/jcs.py`（Python 3.12，零依赖）；共享向量：
`samples/canonicalization/vectors.json`。**Java 与 Python 的测试都必须复现
这些向量**（A 验收项，decisions #11）。

## 1. 算法

`payload_hash = SHA-256( JCS( canonicalObject ) )`，输出**小写十六进制**。

- **JCS = RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme**：
  - 对象成员按键的 **UTF-16 code unit 序**升序排列（ES6 排序，非按码点、
    非按 UTF-8 字节）；
  - 序列化无任何空白：`{"a":1,"b":{"c":null},"d":["x"]}`；
  - 数组**保持原序**（顺序有含义的数组绝不排序）；
  - 字符串按 ES6 `JSON.stringify` 最小转义（`"`、`\`、`\b`、`\t`、`\n`、
    `\f`、`\r`、控制字符 `\u00XX`），其余字符（含中文等非 ASCII）**原样
    UTF-8 输出**；
  - 数字按 ECMAScript `Number::toString(10)`：有限数；`-0 → "0"`；整值
    双精度 → 规范十进制（无 `+`、无前导零、无多余 `.0`）；≥1e21 或 <1e-6
    用 `e+XX`/`e-XX` 指数（指数无前导零）；
  - **禁止重复 JSON 键**：输入含重复键即错误（不是覆盖），必须拒绝；
  - NaN/Infinity、孤立代理对（lone surrogates）拒绝。
- SHA-256 摘要输入是上述 canonical 字节序列的 **UTF-8 编码**，不带结尾换行。

### bigint-as-string 与数字序列化的关系

本项目的计数/revision/seq（bigint）在 JSON 中**一律以字符串传输**
（`^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$`），因此 JCS 的数字序列化规则**只**适用于
`schema_version` 这类真正的 JSON 整数和协议明确允许的小数。字符串带引号，
按字符串规范化——`"42"` 与 `42` 是**不同**的 canonical 输入，哈希不同；
这保证 Java（Long→String）与 Python（int→str）永远不会因数字表示差异
碰撞或分叉。

## 2. canonicalObject 的组装（幂等 payload_hash 的输入）

规范来源：DD 3.3。计算 T13 `payload_hash` 前，服务端把请求组装成如下
canonical 对象（随后整体做第 1 节 JCS + SHA-256）：

1. **operation**：稳定的逻辑操作标识（如 `m1a01.CreateMemberAccessGrant`），
   不是 HTTP requestId。
2. **路径参数**：按 OpenAPI 路径模板的参数名放入（如
   `{"grantId": "..."}`、`{"taskId": "...", "photoVersion": "3"}`），值用
   服务端解析后的规范形式（UUID 小写文本、bigint 十进制字符串）。
3. **语义字段**：请求体/query 中参与业务语义的字段（camelCase 字段名与
   OpenAPI 一致）。
   - **缺省值先展开**：所有有默认语义的可选字段必须在组装时补齐为显式值
     （包括 `null`），再进摘要——“带缺省”和“展开后”的请求必须得到同一哈希
     （见向量 `defaults-expanded-equal-pair-a/b`）。
   - **有序数组不排序**：清单类字段（如 `replacedViews:
     ["front","left","right"]`）是协议有序数组，保持原序（向量
     `array-order-significant-*`）；只有文档明确“集合按协议排序”的字段
     才先按该协议排序。
4. **multipart 图片**：不包含图片字节本身；放入
   `{"imageParts": [{"part": "front", "sha256": "<该 part 原始字节的
   SHA-256 小写 hex>"}, ...]}`——part 名（`metadata` 之外：`face`、
   `front`、`left`、`right`）与逐 part 内容摘要按 part 名字典序排列。
   `metadata` part 的 JSON 作为语义字段（第 3 条）参与。
5. **排除项（可变传输头一律不进摘要）**：`Authorization`、`X-Request-Id`、
   `User-Agent`、`Accept*`、`Date`、multipart 边界、part 顺序、HTTP 传输
   压缩、服务端接收时间等。只排除传输层：Idempotency-Key 本身是 T13 唯一键
   的组成部分，不重复放进 canonicalObject。

同一逻辑请求（同 principal、同 operation、同键、同 canonical 内容）在
Java 与 Python 两侧必须得到**字节相同**的 canonicalObject 序列化与同一
SHA-256；不同语义（哪怕只差一个字段值）**不得碰撞**（向量
`near-collision-closure-final-count-3/4` 演示最小语义差异 → 不同哈希）。

## 3. 实现与验收要求

- 两侧不得自行“近似”实现：以 RFC 8785 + 本文件为准，单元测试必须

# 契约决策记录（A 包建议，待总协调确认后回写主设计）

本文件收录影响**跨语言共享契约**的 gap 决议（源：`.coordination/A/decisions.md`
与任务书 §11 gaps）。均为 A 包在契约层的定稿建议，**不修改 backend/doc/**；
总协调确认后应回写 DD 3.2/9.1 与 API 文档。

## 1. NOT_IMPLEMENTED / 501（decisions #1）

未实现业务 API：HTTP **501** + 标准错误信封，`error.code =
NOT_IMPLEMENTED`（基础层新增码，建议加入 DD 3.2 错误码表），
`retryable=false`，`details` 可含 `apiId`/`plannedPackage`（仅调用方可见
信息）。绝不伪造 200。OpenAPI 中每个 contract-only 端点带
`x-implementation: contract-only` + `'501'` 响应（`NotImplementedEnvelope`
把 code 收紧为 NOT_IMPLEMENTED）。样例
`samples/envelopes/not-implemented-501.json`。

## 2. T13 principal 格式（decisions #2；digest gap 6）

`principal_type ∈ {app_account, gimbal}`；`principal_id`（text）：

- `app_account`：`"<account_uuid>:<installation_id>"`
- `gimbal`：`"<gimbal_uuid>"`

作用域：APP = accountId+installationId；云台 = gimbalId。OpenAPI
`ControllerRef.controllerType` 与之一致。

## 3. T12 owner_type 枚举 + identity_namespace 规则（decisions #3）

`owner_type ∈ {assessment, plan, notification, media, identity_namespace,
system}`；`owner_id` 为 UUID 文本（多态无外键，服务端校验归属）。

- `identity_namespace` 的 `owner_id` =
  **UUIDv5(FIXED_NS, `"<identity_namespace>:<face_subject_ref>"`)**
- `system` 的 `owner_id` = **UUIDv5(FIXED_NS, dedup_key)**

## 4. FIXED_NS 计算值（两侧硬编码，禁止各算各的输入差异）

    FIXED_NS = uuid5(NAMESPACE_DNS, "contest2026_483_yuanxinshixisheng")
             = f988d041-6031-5120-8075-f90b6b05553e

已用 `python3 -c "import uuid; print(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_DNS,
'contest2026_483_yuanxinshixisheng'))"` 验证（NAMESPACE_DNS =
`6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8`，输入为**逐字节小写**的项目目录名，
Java 侧必须用同一输入字符串与 RFC 4122 UUIDv5（SHA-1）实现）。
`samples/jobs/job-handoff-example.json` 的 `owner_id =
b13b43dc-cfb1-5e89-8be2-72564704de79` 即
`uuid5(FIXED_NS, "system:echo:2f6a2b0e-3c1e-4d2b-9b57-1f4c3a5b6d78")`，
两侧测试应复现。

## 5. system.echo 最小跨语言测试任务（decisions #4）

`job_type=system.echo`；`dedup_key=system:echo:<uuid>`；payload
`{"schema_version":1,"message":"<text>","numbers_as_strings":["<bigint>",...]}`
（schema `schemas/payload-system-echo.json`，additionalProperties false）；
`input_revision="0"`。Python handler 先按 JSON Schema 校验 payload，再以
**正确 lease_owner + lease_revision** 完成；**stale-generation 完成（错误
代次）必须失败**——这是要求的测试场景。契约样例 `samples/jobs/`。

## 6. bigint-as-string / schema_version（decisions #9/#10）

跨语言 JSON（HTTP 与任务 payload）中 bigint（计数/revision/seq）一律十
进制字符串，pattern `^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$`（无符号；signed 变体 MVP 不用）；
`schema_version` 用 JSON **整数**，各 payload schema `const: 1`。**本次全部
schema_version 常量选定为 1。**

## 7. payload_hash 规范化（decisions #11）

RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256 小写 hex；组装规则（operation、路径参数、语义字
段、图片 part 名+逐 part 内容摘要、缺省展开、有序数组不排序、禁重复键）
见 `canonicalization.md`；参考实现 `scripts/jcs.py`，共享向量
`samples/canonicalization/vectors.json`（含中文、乱序键、缺省展开、bigint
字符串、数组顺序对、近碰撞对）。Java/Python 测试都必须复现向量。

## 8. 认证/媒体基础协议端点（decisions #6/#7；digest gaps 9/10）

`x-foundation: true`、不计入 27：`POST /api/v1/auth/sms-challenges`、

`DELETE /api/v1/auth/sessions/current`、`GET /api/v1/media/{mediaId}/content`。
媒体端点是**受控读取基础协议**（逐次鉴权、no-store、nosniff、统一 404
RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE、不重定向长效签名 URL）。手机号会话（`/auth/sessions`）
与云台设备会话（`/gimbal-sessions`）并存、命名空间区分。
**唯一双属性端点**：`POST /api/v1/gimbal-sessions` 同时是 27 业务编号
**M2-A01**（API 文档为准）和 decisions #7 列出的基础认证端点——OpenAPI 只
建**一个操作**，同时标 `x-api-id: M2-A01` 与 `x-foundation: true`、
`x-implementation: foundation-auth`（A 包实现，不打 501、不标
contract-only）。统计：业务操作 27 + 基础操作 6 = 33 标记、**去重后 32 个
操作 / 31 条路径**。

## 9. 其他契约级裁量（A 建议）

- **Idempotency-Key 覆盖面**：DD 3.1「业务写接口使用 Idempotency-Key」+
  DD §5 前言「写接口还使用 T13」→ 除 M2-A01（明文规定不用）和 M2-A02
  （心跳去重/顺序 = body 内 observationEpoch/Seq）外的全部业务
  POST/PUT/DELETE 均要求该头（含文档未逐一点名的 M2-A06、M3-A02、
  M5-A01、M2-A04、M4-A04）；文档点名者（M1-A03、M2-A08、M4-A05、M4-A06）
  不变。
- **connectionProof/pairingProof 载体**：API 文档 6.5 说「证明放认证上下文/
  请求头，协议由开发确定」→ OpenAPI 采建议头名 `X-Connection-Proof` /
  `X-Pairing-Proof`（标 x-detail: skeleton），M2-A06/M2-A04/M4-A03 按 DD
  §5 放 body。设备协议冻结前可能改名。
- **枚举编码未冻结者**（connectionStatus、心跳 powerState 扩展、incidents、
  capabilities/state、Plan/Report 正文、推送 registration 等）一律
  `x-detail: skeleton` 或用 UUID/BigintString/时间等已定标识占位，不发明
  业务取值。
- **信封 `data`**：列表端点统一 `{items, nextCursor:string|null}`；成功
  信封 `additionalProperties:false`（外层），`meta` 容忍新增字段。
- **payload 骨架的 x-owner-package 归属**（按任务书 B/C/D 模块映射）：
  assessment.analyze=D、identity.enroll=D、plan.generate=D（C 标注为执行
  接线方）、notification.deliver=B、media.cleanup=D（标注 B/C 人脸媒体由
  总协调定稿）。
